propositions: The plan-review gate lacks a criterion to assess whether a proposed change is actually needed, leaving a 35-65% over-action gap from FixedBench unaddressed.
Bug tickets bypass substantive plan review via exempt-PASS short-circuit in workflow_ops.plan_review_precheck, receiving no DET floor or LLM review.
A new advisory `necessity` criterion (pass-1, 1-TURN, single-turn plan-text judgment) must flag plans that add mechanisms without demonstrating need, accepting well-motivated or no-op outcomes.
Bugs must flow through a lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe only, never blocking) instead of bare exempt-PASS, enabling substantive bug feedback.
The necessity criterion and bug review tier must integrate via existing R1/R3 advisory-criterion seam (routing + registry + rubric + fixtures + auto-monitoring) without bespoke engine branching.
